artworks.title: Souvenirs de voyage (Travel Souvenirs)
artworks.artist: Jules-Ferdinand Jacquemart (artist); Auguste Delâtre (printer); Cadart & Chevalier (publisher)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a collection of worn shoes and boots scattered on a wooden floor. A rolled-up item is leaning against a piece of furniture in the background. The color palette is composed of varying shades of black and white. In the foreground, the shoes and boots are clustered together in a somewhat disordered fashion, with the rolled item positioned directly behind them, leading up to the right side where the wooden furniture leg can be seen along with some draped fabric.

artworks.title: Der Tod als Freund (Death as a Friend)
artworks.medium: wood engraving on wove paper [first edition]
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a print of a robed skeleton in a shadowy interior with an open window in the background. The skeleton is on the left, one hand grasping a large rope, and its head is turned downward, partially covered by a hood. The room is furnished with a staircase on the left and a table on the right with various objects on it, including a book, a pitcher, a cup, and a plate with a chunk of bread. Behind the table, an old man sits on a chair, facing the left. He has a long beard, a balding head, and his eyes are closed. His hands are in his lap, and a ring of keys hangs from his tunic. In the center of the print, an open window lets in light, revealing a distant landscape with a setting or rising sun. The print is detailed, showing the wood grain of the floorboards and beams. There is a line of text below the print.

artworks.title: Der Tod als Erwürger (Death as a Strangler)
artworks.medium: wood engraving on wove paper [first edition]
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a print of a robed skeleton in a shadowy interior with an open window in the background. The skeleton is on the left, one hand grasping a large rope and its head turned downward, partially covered by a hood. The room is furnished with a staircase on the left and a table on the right with various objects on it, including a book, a pitcher, a cup, and a plate with a chunk of bread. Behind the table, an old man sits on a chair, facing the left. He has a long beard, a balding head, and his eyes are closed. His hands are in his lap, and a ring of keys hangs from his tunic. In the center of the print, an open window reveals a distant landscape with a setting or rising sun. The print is detailed, showing the wood grain of the floorboards and beams. There is a line of text below the print.

artworks.title: Der Tod als Freund (Death as a Friend)
artworks.medium: wood engraving on brown wove paper [third edition]
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a black and white illustration featuring a hooded figure dressed in long robes standing next to an elderly individual seated in an ornate chair. The setting is a room with large windows showing a landscape with the sun.

artworks.title: Der Tod als Freund (Death as a Friend)
artworks.medium: wood engraving on wove paper [second edition]
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a skeletal figure in a cloak holding a violin surrounded by various bodies on the ground. The background features figures climbing through windows and chaos. The setting includes architectural elements like arches and a chandelier, implying an indoor location. The use of linework and contrast creates depth and drama in the drawing.

artworks.title: Ancient Trees in the Roman Campagna
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a large and gnarled tree with a man standing beside it on a small incline. There is no clear horizon line visible. The tree's trunk is captured with textured bark and dramatic curves using broad brushstrokes, conveying age and grandeur. The color palette consists of earthy browns, muted greens, and soft grays. The man is dressed in simple attire and blends into the scene, adding to the rustic atmosphere. The background is kept minimal, focusing on the tree and the figure.

artworks.title: Grotto Interior
artworks.medium: watercolor over graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Donald Stone
artworks.description: The painting depicts the interior of a cave with a view towards an opening in the distance. The focus is on the cavern interior with a glimpse of light from the opening. The brushstrokes are loose and fluid, with layered washes of watercolor creating textured surfaces resembling rocky structures. The color palette consists of earthy tones like browns, grays, and muted blues, evoking a dim, natural atmosphere with faint light beyond. The overall impression is one of dimness and enclosure within the cave, with subtle light hinting at an exit or outside space in the distance.

artworks.title: An Elegant Young Lady with a Lace Cap
artworks.medium: pastel on beige prepared canvas (on a strainer)
artworks.creditLine: The Ahmanson Foundation
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a seated position, with her head turned slightly to the side. She has delicate features, fair skin, light brown eyes, and soft pink lips. She wears a decorative headscarf and attire with a ruffled collar and sleeves. A light material is draped over her shoulders with a lace-like texture. She is adorned with pearl earrings and a pearl choker necklace. The background is dark.

artworks.title: Augustusburg Castle Seen from the River
artworks.medium: etching with brown wash on wove paper, on an old mount
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image displays a rural landscape with a river, hills, trees, a castle or manor on a hill, and various figures engaged in activities like fishing and tending to herds of cattle and sheep. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic sepia tone with fine detailing of the brushstrokes.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Golden Calf
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash, over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with a group of figures around a plinth with a lion statue. The composition includes human and mythical figures gathered around the pedestal with a lion statue. The scene is set in a landscape with trees and mountains. The figures show dramatic gestures and poses. The drawing style features fluid lines and sepia-toned washes, reminiscent of a baroque influence.

artworks.title: Moonlit Landscape with a Monk Walking near a Palace
artworks.medium: brown wax with scratching out on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a figure walking with a cane on a path by a large tree, with a building in the background and a warm sepia color palette. The tree dominates the left side, while the building is in the upper right corner, partially hidden by vegetation. Brushstrokes are detailed for the tree and smooth for the sky and distant structures, creating a contrast between light and shadow.

artworks.title: Aspect que commencent dèja a avoir ...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer, 1983)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of stylized individuals leaning out of windows on an urban building. They have exaggerated facial features, varied hairstyles, and wear simple clothing. They face upwards with a crowded, anticipatory expression. Other individuals watch from more windows in the background. The scene suggests nighttime in an urban environment.

artworks.title: Les planetes étant elles-mêmes
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of celestial figures observing the sky with telescopes. The drawing portrays classical mythological figures sitting on clouds while holding or peering through telescopes. The figures have stars above their heads and are detailed with expressive facial features and draped in flowing robes and armor. The title "La Comète de 1857" and a caption in French at the bottom suggest a connection to a comet. The figures are gazing towards the night sky, implying anticipation of an astronomical event. The drawing is done in a monochrome style with fine lines and shading capturing the texture of the clouds and garments.

artworks.title: De l'utilité de la crinoline pour frauder l'octroi
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two women in elaborate dresses. The artwork depicts the women in dresses with voluminous crinolines. One of the women's skirts is lifted to reveal hidden goods such as bottles and food items underneath. The exaggerated fullness of the skirts suggests they are being used to transport concealed items. The style of the drawing emphasizes humor and social commentary, reflecting a satirical approach commonly found in 19th-century illustrations.

artworks.title: Oh! Mamechaboulard ... qu'est-ce qu'y va ... arriver ...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The image shows two elderly women interacting. One woman is leaning forward slightly, holding an open book or paper. She has gray hair under a bonnet and wears a long, loose-fitting dress with rolled-up sleeves. The other woman stands facing her with her hands clasped near her waist. She also has gray hair under a bonnet, and wears a long dress with an apron. The background is a simple room with a wall and wooden shelf or paneling. The style of the artwork is vintage, resembling a hand-drawn sketch or lithograph.

artworks.title: Toute entière a l'etude de son role ...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The image is a black and white illustration showing a woman and a child. The woman is standing with one hand on her chest and the other holding an open book. Her facial expression is dramatic, with her mouth open, and she has curly hair. She is wearing a long dress. Next to her, a child is shown upside down, lying on the floor among broken crockery. The child appears to be wearing a dress and shoes. Around them are chairs, a table with utensils, and a spilled drink. The background shows a wall with faint outlines of plates or trays. The style is sketch-like, conveying movement and clutter.

artworks.title: N'allant aux bains froids que ...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The image shows three men from head to barefoot. The man on the left has a slender build, crossed arms, short dark hair, and angular facial features. The man in the center is older, wrapped in a towel, balding, and has a surprised expression. The man on the right has a muscular build, confident stance, short hair, a prominent chin, and is wearing trunks. The background is an interior bathing facility with tiled walls and two other individuals' heads peeking above the water.

artworks.title: Une erreur excusable
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: Two individuals are depicted in the image. The man, dressed in a tall hat and a long coat, faces forward with his head turned to the left. He has a simple facial structure with a prominent nose and a composed expression. The woman sits next to him, also facing the left with a slight profile view. She wears a bonnet that covers her hair, a long-sleeved top, and an expansive skirt. The lower part of the image includes chickens on the ground. The background features minimal details, such as a building on the left and trees on the right. The image has a monochrome color scheme and suggests a rural setting.

artworks.title: Ce qu'on voit a peu près tous les jours
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a political assembly. The top section shows a chaotic scene in an assembly hall with numerous figures seated in the audience, all focused on an individual speaking from a podium. The bottom section depicts two figures engaged in a secretive conversation behind curtains. The drawing captures the spirited and sometimes contentious nature of political assemblies, as well as the undercurrent of private discussions that can occur.

artworks.title: Un réconciliation, scène de haute comédie ...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The image shows two male figures embracing each other. They have exaggerated features and are dressed in comedic attire. The background includes other exaggerated figures, creating a theatrical setting.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome Hearing the Trumpet of the Last Judgement
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper [counterproof]
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure approaching a reclining, elderly figure. The winged figure is reaching towards the elder with an extended hand holding a serpent-entwined staff. The elder is semi-clad in draped fabric, seated amidst rocks and books, with a skull resting on the surface beside him. To the right in the image, another face is partly visible, seemingly carved or depicted on stone. The scene is detailed with emphasis on texture and movement through line work.

artworks.title: Omnia Vincit Amor [Apollo and Daphne]
artworks.artist: Robert van Audenaerd, after Carlo Maratta
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on two attached sheets of laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of David H. McDonnell
artworks.description: The image features multiple classical figures in dynamic poses. Most figures are shown full-bodied, with some overlapping or partially hidden. The central group includes male and female figures engaged in various activities. The figures have classical facial features and flowing hair, depicted in an idealized form. They are mostly nude, with some drapery covering certain parts. Trees, a cherubic figure, and a flowing water stream are also depicted. In the background, there is a landscape with hills and clouds.

artworks.title: Voisin, êtres-vous comme moi? ...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Dr. Armand Hammer)
artworks.description: The image shows two men in an outdoor setting. The man on the left is standing sideways with arms crossed, wearing a cap and a thick coat with a hood. The man on the right is facing forward with hands in pockets, wearing a large coat and a voluminous scarf, topped by a wide-brimmed hat. Both men have notable facial features. The background includes a leafless tree and dense shrubbery, suggesting a winter countryside. The illustration has a sketchy, etched quality.

artworks.title: Leech
artworks.artist: Charles B. J. Févret de Saint-Mémin
artworks.medium: mezzotint and engraving in black on wove paper mounted to brown wove paper
artworks.dimensions:
image (irregular): 5.56 × 5.56 cm (2 3/16 × 2 3/16 in.)
sheet (trimmed to plate): 6.83 × 6.19 cm (2 11/16 × 2 7/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of William Wilson Corcoran)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper body of a person in profile view, facing to the right. The person is upright with a slight tilt of the head. The facial features include a nose and a jawline. The hair is styled in tight curls, gathered at the back into a braid secured with a ribbon. The person is dressed in a formal coat with a high collar and a cravat around the neck. The coat has a double-breasted design with visible buttons. The background is a simple, unembellished circular design. There are no visible jewelry or additional objects held by the person. The lower part of the portrait includes the text "Drawn & engr'd. by St. Memin Philadel'a" and the name "Leech" is written below the image.
